question: In the RSC Advances study of biochar loading in dual-phase MIL-100(Al)/MIL-110(Al) hybrids for CO2 adsorption, what CO2-TPD strong-site density (280-400 °C) did BC-10 show, and what is reported for BC-0 in that range?
rendered:
According to page 10 of the excerpt, BC-10 showed a strong-site density of 2.781 mmol g−1 in the CO2-TPD range of 280-400 °C. 

BC-0 did not show a clear resolved strong-site density in this range, as it was not clearly resolved for the pristine mixed-phase framework.
